issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared across all instances and operating on the shared static stock). In the solution implementation, calculateTotalPrice is declared as an instance method (non-static). This contradicts the textual specification and can confuse students about whether calculateTotalPrice should be static and how it should access the shared stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make calculateTotalPrice static to match the problem specification and to work with the shared static stock. Change its signature to: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and update any internal references accordingly (it should use the static stock field). Ensure the documentation and UML/instructions consistently state the method's static requirement.
